fact: CPJ states that journalists Comlan Hugues Sossoukpè and Ali Moumouni, held without trial for 10 months by 24 May 2026, remained imprisoned on 1 September 2026 on charges including harassment through electronic communications, which CPJ says were brought in retaliation for critical reporting.
CPJ states that journalist Angela Kpeidja was sentenced to 12 months in prison for asking questions on Facebook about the December 2025 coup attempt as it unfolded.

MFWA reports journalist Angela Kpeidja was detained on 16 December 2025 over two Facebook posts questioning the security authorities on the day of the attempted coup, and the special prosecutor sought two years, one firm, on 11 May 2026 under Digital Code Article 550.

The Media Foundation for West Africa reports that editor Olivier Allochémé was arrested on 9 October 2025 and placed in pre-trial detention on 16 October 2025 by the CRIET for 'publishing false news via social media' in a Facebook editorial alleging President Talon had surveilled the former Speaker, with a hearing on 30 October 2025 adjourned to 15 January 2026.
